# Deliver customer pagination

Select Graph Orchestrator in the Copilot agent picker first. If this skill is invoked under another role, ask the engineer to switch before editing. Deliver `issues/customer-pagination.md` using `contracts/customer-pagination.md` and `.github/skills/engineering-graph/SKILL.md`. This invocation approves the documented array-to-envelope change for this app only. Use at most three shared edit-and-check cycles. Delegate to the named specialist agents, show actual delegation, record routing and evidence, and stop at human approval or escalation. Do not change requirements or supplied checks. See `demo/prompts/graph.md` for the equivalent plain-text launch prompt.
